sources.observation: The northern wall shows three successive rising roof waves, vertical light cladding and dark glazing. A lower wave edge meets the waterfront pavilion.

sources.credit: Saberwyn, see linked file for license
sources.observation: The long roofs run along the waterfront building. Shorter low wings flank the recessed east promenade. The lighthouse and ships are independent structures.

limitations: The cross sections and crest heights are estimated from photographs. The model covers the main museum exterior. The waterfront and nearby vessels use the host map.
